_why: The video lab notebook (social/DAILY.md, 'The daily mix'). Each day runs two experiments, each changing ONE thing from the countdown format. 'backlog' is what to try, best bets first; 'results' records each run, scored 72 hours after posting: 1,000+ views and 9+ s watch = promote, under 500 = drop, between = retry once with one tweak.

baseline.note: Famous-name groupings did best: UC 17,933 (241 shares), Penn 5,169, Ivy 3,888. Plain state groupings in week 2 ran 600-2,500.

backlog.idea: Part 2 of the UC video (17.9K views): the same 9 UC campuses ranked by a different number, e.g. Asian restaurants nearby or the busiest food street. Open with 'You asked for part 2.'
backlog.why: TikTok pushes follow-ups to viewers of a hit.

backlog.idea: Head-to-head: Alabama vs Auburn (27 vs 21, close), USC vs UCLA (94 vs 14), Michigan vs Ohio State (224 vs 86). Split-screen maps, counts climb together, winner at the end.
backlog.why: Rivalry comments and shares; tests whether a close race holds people longer than a list.

backlog.changes: school name hidden until the end
backlog.idea: 'Guess the campus': the map with no name while the count climbs, three multiple-choice options on screen, reveal at the end.
backlog.why: Withholding the answer should raise watch time and comments.

backlog.changes: grouping chosen for fame, not geography
backlog.idea: Stanford vs Harvard vs MIT vs Princeton vs Yale and other household names, ranked by restaurants within a 10-minute walk.
backlog.why: Every famous-name video beat the plain state ones.

backlog.changes: a city's colleges instead of a state's
backlog.idea: Every college in one city: Boston, New York, Chicago, LA. Check each campus map first (Boston University's count looked low).
The same countdown cut to the top 3.
backlog.why: Tests whether completion rate beats total watch time.

backlog.changes: one surprising national number, no schools
backlog.idea: e.g. 'Pizza places outnumber salad places 20 to 1 near US campuses' (from the campus data).
backlog.why: Tests a broad hook against a school hook.

backlog.idea: Reply to a comment on a hit ('Where's my school?'). Needs the owner to read the comments and pass one on.
backlog.why: Comment replies are a strong TikTok growth signal.

backlog.idea: The owner records a voiceover for one countdown.
